Author: EvolvedXIV
Name: Job Gauge Evolved
Description:
Draws improved job gauges that you can resize, move and recolour, with a settings section and an on/off switch per job. Game windows cover the gauges like they cover the game's own.

Viper: the Vipersight blades and the Serpent Offerings gauge in one. A blade lights up when the game would recommend its button from your Honed and venom buffs, and goes dark when the buffs run out. At the finisher a glow around the orb shows a flank or a rear attack, and the blade of the finisher your venom empowers lights up with it. Lit parts glow with a pulse of energy every 2 seconds, and a lit blade's colour is added to its steel; the centre's colours and glow are set apart from the blades'. Also shows the Anguine Tributes and the Reawaken timer, the gauge value and your Rattling Coils.

Open the settings with /jge.
